name: Elasticsearch — Logs & Metrics Observability with YugabyteDB
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-elasticsearch.sh && echo "" && echo ">> Terminal > Run Task > elasticsearch-demo   (guided YB observability demo)" && echo ">> Terminal > Run Task > elasticsearch-ws     (Workshop shell for manual exercises)"'

tasks.label: elasticsearch-demo
tasks.detail: YugabyteDB logs + Prometheus metrics shipped via OTel into Elasticsearch — observability demo (init-elasticsearch/prompt.sh)
tasks.command: bash .devcontainer/scripts/wait-for-svc.sh 'http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health' 'Elasticsearch :9200' 'http://localhost:5601/api/status' 'Kibana :5601' 'pid:/tmp/elasticsearch-init/filebeat.pid' 'Filebeat' 'pid:/tmp/elasticsearch-init/metricbeat.pid' 'Metricbeat' && cd init-elasticsearch && echo '🔍 elasticsearch-demo  —  Elasticsearch + YugabyteDB Observability' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

tasks.label: elasticsearch-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for Elasticsearch + YugabyteDB manual exercises (init-elasticsearch/)
tasks.command: bash .devcontainer/scripts/wait-for-svc.sh 'http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health' 'Elasticsearch :9200' 'http://localhost:5601/api/status' 'Kibana :5601' 'pid:/tmp/elasticsearch-init/filebeat.pid' 'Filebeat' 'pid:/tmp/elasticsearch-init/metricbeat.pid' 'Metricbeat' && cd init-elasticsearch && echo '🔍 elasticsearch-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual curl / ysqlsh commands here' && exec bash
